key_fiscal_facts.value_text: ~85-90% govt take (20% royalty + 41% Sonangol equity + 50% IRP on contractor share)
~50% cost recovery (concession cost allocation, not PSC cap)
50% IRP (Imposto sobre o Rendimento do Petroleo) — Angola statutory petroleum income tax
Concession equity split: ~10-20% IOC contractor share after royalty + IRP
~20% of gross production (Angola Block 0 concession standard)
